title: Dynamic machine learning architecture integrating time-phased predictions for acute kidney injury following extracorporeal membrane oxygenation.
summary: Time-phased ML predicts acute kidney injury before and during ECMO in 344 patients; the source reports held-out AUCs around 0.73 pre-ECMO and 0.80 on-ECMO and five-fold evaluation. The result is exploratory single-center risk prediction. The result is reported in the Frontiers in Physiology. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: Dynamic models update AKI risk at pre/on-ECMO phases from clinical variables.
